validate-azure-ad-token.failed-validation-error-message: Sign in with a Microsoft Entra token for the agent gateway.

set-variable.name: agw-tier
set-variable.value: @{ var g = ((string)context.Variables["agw-groups"]); if (g.Contains(",00000000-0000-0000-0000-00000000a002,")) { return "power"; } if (g.Contains(",00000000-0000-0000-0000-00000000a001,")) { return "standard"; } return ""; }

set-variable.name: agw-team
set-variable.value: @{ var g = ((string)context.Variables["agw-groups"]); if (g.Contains(",00000000-0000-0000-0000-00000000b001,")) { return "secops"; } if (g.Contains(",00000000-0000-0000-0000-00000000b002,")) { return "it-ops"; } return "unassigned"; }

set-variable.name: agw-allowed
set-variable.value: @{ var g = ((string)context.Variables["agw-groups"]); var a = ""; if (g.Contains(",00000000-0000-0000-0000-00000000c001,")) { a += ",cve-triage"; } if (g.Contains(",00000000-0000-0000-0000-00000000c002,")) { a += ",threat-brief"; } return a.Length > 0 ? a.Substring(1) : a; }

set-variable.name: agw-cost-center
set-variable.value: @{ var t = ((string)context.Variables["agw-team"]); if (t == "secops") { return "1001"; } if (t == "it-ops") { return "1002"; } if (t == "unassigned") { return "9000"; } return ""; }

return-response.set-body: {"error": {"code": "no_tier", "message": "Your account is not in an agent access tier. Ask for access to an agents group."}}
